recentItems.title: Air defense couldn't help! 350 drones target Moscow & CRUSHING strike on airfield in Rostov!
recentItems.description:
Russia finds itself under a new wave of pressure: massive drone attacks on Rostov and Moscow, the shutdown of the Yaroslavl oil refinery, and reports of preparations for a potential new mobilization. This episode also covers €3.3 billion in EU aid for Ukraine, the development of the FREYJA missile defense system, negotiations over a new US military base in Poland, and a sanctions bill that could hit Russian energy, banks, the "shadow fleet," and buyers of oil and gas. Kyiv calls on its partners to synchronize pressure on the Kremlin.

recentItems.title: Ukraine managed to HIDE an entire counteroffensive: Russians did not expect such a POWERFUL STRIKE
recentItems.description:
Operation "Vivaldi" demonstrated how the Armed Forces of Ukraine are changing the rules of modern warfare in the Lyman direction. Ukrainian forces cleared nearly 75 km² of Russian infiltration and liberated another 10 km². Countering enemy drones, jamming electronic warfare, striking logistics, and maintaining informational silence were the keys to regaining the element of surprise. This episode covers how Ukraine destroys the entire supply system of Russian UAVs, creates conditions for mechanized assaults, and applies similar logic when striking critical targets deep inside Russia.

recentItems.title: €3.3B for missiles and drones EU dramatically BOOSTS Ukrainian air defense
recentItems.description:
In this episode — the aftermath of the strike on the Yaroslavl oil refinery, the front-line situation, and an assessment of Russian losses. Ukrainian forces are holding back attacks in the Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka, and Lyman directions, while analysts report the disruption of part of Russia's plans in the Donetsk region. Also covered — a strike on a passenger train in the Kharkiv region, an attack on Zaporizhzhia, demands to return the Zaporizhzhia NPP to Ukrainian control, new EU defense funding, the development of the FREYJA missile defense system, and Kyiv's stance on illegal Russian "elections" in the occupied territories.
